project: Ship 1 + Ship 2 — Format & UX Pack + Narrative Pack v1
description: ONE PR landing Ship 1 (6 embed-format changes) and Ship 2 (4 narrative-pack changes) per plan .omc/plans/ship1-ship2-format-narrative.md. Pure rendering + LLM prompting work; no new data fetches.

stories.title: Ship 1 N1+N3+N4: Cashtag, compact money, arrow icons in embed.py
acceptanceCriteria: embed.py _fmt_cashtag(ticker) returns '$TICKER' for plain ticker, '$TICKER' for $TICKER (idempotent)
embed.py _fmt_money_compact(value) returns '$2.4M' for 2400000, '$437K' for 437000, '$1.2B' for 1200000000, '$120' for 120, '—' for None
embed.py _arrow_for_level(level, current) returns '↑' when level > current, '↓' when level < current, '⇄' when within 0.1% of current
embed.py build_embed title uses _fmt_cashtag (renders '$NVDA — Full Analysis')
embed.py SL/TP1/TP2/TP3 fields render with arrow icons relative to current_price
embed.py Buy Zone field includes ⇄ arrow when zone brackets current

stories.title: Ship 1 N2: Direction emoji upgrade (🟢/🔴/⚪)
acceptanceCriteria: embed.py _direction_emoji returns '🟢 BULLISH' for 'BULLISH'
embed.py _direction_emoji returns '🔴 BEARISH' for 'BEARISH'
embed.py _direction_emoji returns '⚪ NEUTRAL' for 'NEUTRAL' or unknown
embed.py build_embed direction line + Direction field reflect new emoji set

stories.title: Ship 1 N5: Plain-English one-liner under each level (per-field template)
acceptanceCriteria: embed.py _level_oneliner(field_name, value, current) returns italic markdown string explaining the level
Stop-loss one-liner mentions 'exit' or 'invalidates' when level < current and direction bullish
TP1/TP2/TP3 one-liners are emitted (non-empty italic) when value is not None
Each level field's 'value' includes both the arrow+price line AND the italic one-liner separated by newline

stories.title: Ship 1 N7: Relative date phrasing for earnings_date and Next Catalyst
acceptanceCriteria: embed.py _fmt_relative_date(iso_date) returns 'today' when delta==0, 'in 1 session' when delta==1, 'in N sessions' when 0<delta<=7, 'in N days' for >7
_fmt_relative_date returns 'N days ago' for negative deltas, ISO fallback for invalid input
embed.py Next Catalyst field uses relative phrasing when next_catalyst_days is set (e.g. 'in 3 sessions')
Earnings information embedded in narrative or fields uses relative phrasing when within 7 days

stories.title: Ship 2 M1+M2+M3+M6: Narrator prompt emits TL;DR, Bear Case, Market vs Our view, Risks & mitigants
acceptanceCriteria: narrator.py _build_constraints_block contains literal string '**TL;DR:**' as required first-line prefix
narrator.py _build_constraints_block requires '**What could go wrong:**' section header (M2 Bear Case)
narrator.py _build_constraints_block requires 'Market view:' / 'Our view:' / 'Catalyst:' sentence pattern (M3 variant perception)
narrator.py _build_constraints_block requires '**Risks & mitigants:**' section with bulleted risk → mitigant items (M6)
narrator.py constraints include the contradiction-defense clause: 'Bear Case must acknowledge the COMPUTED SIGNAL'S direction'
narrator.py constraints include the evidence-citation clause: 'Every Bear Case sentence must cite a specific evidence row' with [evidence:N] marker convention
narrator.py _build_constraints_block emits all four new clauses regardless of swing_v2_enabled flag

stories.title: Ship 2 quality_bar.py: structural rejection of narratives missing required tokens
acceptanceCriteria: quality_bar.py has_required_sections(narrative) returns True iff narrative contains '**TL;DR:**', '**What could go wrong:**', AND '**Risks & mitigants:**'
has_required_sections returns False if any of the three tokens is missing
narrator.py synthesize_narrative re-prompts (one retry) when has_required_sections returns False on first attempt
After retry, if still missing required sections, returns ('', 'fallback_data_only') to caller

stories.title: TL;DR extraction + display in embed
acceptanceCriteria: embed.py _extract_tldr(narrative) returns the TL;DR sentence text (without the '**TL;DR:**' prefix) if present, else empty string
build_embed renders the extracted TL;DR as the first line of description (above direction line), bolded
When TL;DR is missing, embed falls back to the existing direction-line-only header (no error)
